name: Financial Assistance for Scaling Mount Everest and Other Inaccessible Mountains of the World
benefit: > **Financial Support for Mountaineers:** - Financial assistance ranging from ₹50,000/- to ₹10,00,000/- is provided to individuals depending on the height and difficulty of the mountain scaled. - A maximum of ₹15,00,000/- is provided to those who successfully climb Mount Everest.
_eligibility_text: > **Eligibility Criteria for Adventurer:** - The applicant should have successfully scaled Mount Everest or other inaccessible mountains of the world. - The applicant should be aged between 18 to 45 years as on 31st December of the respective year. - The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat, Mount Abu, or any other Indian state. - The applicant from Gujarat or Mount Abu should have completed a coaching course from the Swami Vivekananda Mountaineering Institute, Mount Abu. - The applicant must be physically and mentally fit. - The applicant must not have any criminal record. - The applicant who has already participated once in the camp during the same year will not be allowed to participate again. > **Eligibility Criteria for Coach or Instructor:** - The applicant should have provided services in Artificial Rock Climbing Courses or Coaching Courses held at Mount Abu. - The applicant must have completed the Method of Instructor Course and Search and Rescue Course. - The applicant should possess sufficient mountaineering experience and certifications relevant to instructing rock climbing activities. > **Eligibility Criteria for Subject Experts:** - The applicant must be one of the following: - A subject expert or experienced individual from any Ministry or Department of the Government. - A representative of an international or national mountaineering association or institution recognized by the government. - A person who has received National or International awards/medals or has similar significant achievements in mountaineering from recognized associations. > **Note:** Preference will be given to applicants who are participating for the first time.
